basis: VIAVI’s FY2023 Q1 results release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found. Its condensed consolidated statements of operations report net revenue of $310.2 million for the three months ended October 1, 2022, and $326.8 million for the three months ended October 2, 2021. The actual was $260,000 below the $310.46 million threshold. VIAVI reported a 5.1% year-over-year decline.

coverage.detail: May 3, 2022. The preceding earnings cycle gave net revenue guidance of $315 million to $329 million for FY2022 Q4, the quarter ending July 2, 2022.
May 3 earnings call. Management discussed the June-quarter outlook and its fiscal-year expectations. No qualifying consolidated revenue forecast for the quarter ending October 1 was identified.
August 11, 2022. VIAVI explicitly guided FY2023 Q1 net revenue to $317 million to $331 million. Even the low end exceeded $310.46 million.
September 13, 2022. On Analyst Day, VIAVI expressly reaffirmed the $317 million to $331 million revenue range for the quarter ending October 1.
September 13 Analyst Day presentation, Exhibit 99.2. The financial targets covered VIAVI’s multiyear strategy through FY2025. No lower consolidated FY2023 Q1 revenue ceiling was identified.
October 18, 2022. VIAVI scheduled the release for November 3 after market close. The notice contained no preliminary sales figure or revised range.

November 3 earnings call. The CFO attributed the miss to an unexpected demand slowdown in the final three weeks and compared the $310.2 million actual with the $317 million to $331 million guidance. The intervening disclosure search found no qualifying preannouncement.

The November 4 Form 10-Q confirms both reported consolidated amounts. Note 5 records the May and July business combinations. Note 19 places the Jackson Labs acquisition after quarter-end. The comparison uses each period’s reported consolidated revenue.

publication_date_evidence: VIAVI’s investor-relations results release carries a November 3, 2022 Chandler dateline and says the company reported results that day. Its October 18 notice had scheduled publication for November 3 after market close, and management discussed the actual on the November 3 call.
